notes.title: Update 1.2.0 is Live Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43832956/910913997ca3b4a7e3443359b91238b3f9ac9e3e.jpg[/img]

[h2]What’s new?[/h2]

[b]-> Cross-platform is now available![/b]

In our latest update, we are thrilled to announce the support for Cross-Play functionality, a feature long anticipated by our community. It allows players across different platforms to join forces together, or compete, in high-octane pit stop challenges, fostering a more unified and expansive friendship anytime, anywhere! Have fun, Crew ;)

[b]-> Added simplified Chinese localization[/b]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]

- The 'Load Game' screen in the French localization will now display a missing progress percentage.
- No more waiting. The eternal loading when the client loses connection during level loading has now been fixed.
- Fixed the issue where the plunger might get stuck on the conveyor belt.
- Fixed an issue causing network client controls to freeze after interactions on moving platforms, notably in Chapter 2, Level 9, as frequently reported.
- Fixed the issue where the engine might get stuck between the car and the fence while being carried by the player in Chapter 2, Level 4.
- Fixed the extended game closure time after long online play sessions.
- Fixed the missing 'release button' ground hole at the upper pit stop in Chapter 4, Level 2.
- Fixed the looped animation that happens when the host and a player, who are carrying the engine, get hit by a car on the race track.
- The 'Split Keyboard' button will now be hidden when the 'Join Game' pop-up is open, as it should.
- Fixed the rope length on movable gas stations from 20m to 10m. No more manipulating ropes across half the map and race track to fuel your cars. That was not fun.

And more!

Have fun, Crew! ;)

notes.title: Speed Crew is now Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43832956/57f43f007ad9e0d7e4ec62d7c92a7429f796dda1.jpg[/img]

It's official, Crew!

We are proud to announce that Speed Crew is now verified by Valve as a fully functional title on Steam Deck! This means seamless, optimized gameplay for all the pit stop enthusiasts out there, right at your fingertips — wherever you go.

So, gather your team, strategize your moves, and get ready for an adrenaline-pumping adventure that you can enjoy anytime, anywhere.

notes.title: Speed Crew has arrived!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=knUctTqCf2s;full][/previewyoutube]

Get ready, because Speed Crew is finally here! Gather your crew, or go solo - the choice is yours. Dive into racing championships, repair arriving cars, explore 48 levels across 4 Chapters, unlock sponsored races to find hidden treasures, defeat Dominion, and get your victory. Four decades of racing, from the 70s to the 00s, are waiting for you!

[b]Unlock Arcade mode for even more challenges![/b]

Check out our new Sabotage Mode. Play as Dominion Torrento himself, and disrupt your teammates' championship runs. Your aim is to ruin their efforts, while they strive to win and give you a well-deserved slap ;)

[b]KEY FEATURES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Local and online multiplayer options.
[*] Engaging storyline with animated and voiced cinematics, featuring 4 racing championships spanning 4 decades.
[*] Unique 48 levels to explore.
[*] Arcade mode for those seeking true challenges.
[*] Dynamic pit lane filled with a variety of tools, hazards, and car issues to keep the action intense.
[*] Customization: pick your character, hat, and costume color.
[*] Stylized 3D graphics with a retro touch and custom-made soundtrack for each decade.
[*] Suitable for all ages and skill levels.
[*] Slaps! Slap Dominion, slap cars, slap your teammates, slap that release button. Become a true pit stop tyrant!
[/list]


Have fun, Crew! :)

notes.title: Speed Crew is an Overcooked-like that swaps out kitchens for pit stops
notes.content:
If I'm over at someone's place with a bunch of people and they say, "Let's play Overcooked!" I will always visibly recoil. The game is bad for my blood pressure and for the solidity of my friendships. So, I am terrified by the prospect of Speed Crew, an Overcooked-like set in racing pit stops as opposed to kitchens. I gave it a whirl and it has promise! Even if I now need a big lie down. I am not cut out for jobs involving manual labour, nor games where I play as someone who needs to perform manual labour.

Read more

notes.title: Speed Crew's Release Date Set for January 31st!
notes.content:
Exciting news, Crew! Speed Crew's release date is officially set for [u][b]January 31st[/b][/u]! Mark your calendars and get ready for some chaos with your friends & family.

But that's not all! Alongside the main campaign, we are thrilled to announce a new, shiny game mode for your team to enjoy together. Take on the role of Dominion himself! Disrupt your rivals' races, break their cars, and master the true art of chaos. Indeed, a new level of friendship will unlock between you and your friends here :D

Prepare for an action-packed experience that combines strategy, teamwork, and lots of fun. So, rev up your engines and get ready to experience the ultimate pit stop adventure.

[previewyoutube=MnroFuvLu_I;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Important Update: Speed Crew Steam Launch Rescheduled to Q1 2024
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 


We are grateful for your feedback and ideas about the available Demo and your invaluable thoughts during the Gamescom event. Speed Crew is our first game, and we aim to make it an unforgettable experience for all players. We've decided to take some extra time and move the Steam release date to [b]Q1 2024[/b]. This delay will enable us to fine-tune the game and deliver even more engaging content to you. Here's a spoiler alert - we're in the process of developing a new game mode alongside the full main campaign, which we hope you'll enjoy as well on release :)

Want to learn more about what's under the hood? Join our social media channels and Discord to be on track with all the latest buzz.
